l4_steps.name: Receive inbound flight movement data
l4_steps.input: Inbound OOOI messages and updated ETA from ACARS
l4_steps.output: Confirmed stand assignment and estimated on-block time
l4_steps.kpi: Stand assignment confirmed ≥30 min before ETA
l4_steps.pain_point: Late gate changes due to ATC slot revisions or prior turn overrun cause cascading resource conflicts — AMS does not auto-trigger GSE reallocation

l4_steps.name: Allocate ramp resources to inbound flight
l4_steps.input: Stand assignment, aircraft type, turnaround time target
l4_steps.output: GSE allocation plan (GPU, belt loaders, pushback tug, stairs/JBs)
l4_steps.kpi: Resource plan published ≥20 min before on-block; GSE utilisation ≥75%
l4_steps.pain_point: GSE availability gaps during peak banks — GroundStar planning horizon is 4 hours; sub-contracted handling agents may not sync real-time equipment status

l4_steps.name: Confirm stand readiness and brief ramp team
l4_steps.input: Incoming stand occupancy status, previous turn clearance confirmation
l4_steps.output: Stand ready flag set; ramp crew briefed on aircraft type, turn time, and special loads
l4_steps.kpi: Stand cleared ≥10 min before on-block for 95% of turns
l4_steps.pain_point: Stand conflicts when previous turn is delayed — SITA AMS does not automatically notify ramp crew of stand swap; verbal communication gaps cause missed briefings

l4_steps.name: Marshal aircraft to allocated stand
l4_steps.input: Stand ready confirmation, aircraft taxiing signal from Tower
l4_steps.output: Aircraft parked on stand with wheel position confirmed
l4_steps.kpi: On-block within 2 min of scheduled on-block time for 80% of turns
l4_steps.pain_point: Tight apron geometry at congested airports leads to proximity incidents — SITA AMS does not provide real-time apron conflict alerting; relies on manual visual clearance

l4_steps.name: Position chocks, connect GPU and air bridge
l4_steps.input: Aircraft on-block confirmation from marshaller
l4_steps.output: Chocks placed, GPU connected, aircraft on external power, air bridge docked
l4_steps.kpi: GPU connected within 3 min of on-block; APU off within 5 min of on-block
l4_steps.pain_point: APU-off compliance is monitored manually — airlines incur fuel burn penalty and noise fines if APU is left running; GroundStar task completion is self-reported, not sensor-verified

l4_steps.name: Conduct FOD check and open aircraft holds
l4_steps.input: Aircraft chocked and powered; airside safety clearance
l4_steps.output: FOD-clear certification logged; hold doors open and belt loaders positioned
l4_steps.kpi: FOD check completed within 5 min of chocking; zero FOD incidents per 10,000 turns
l4_steps.pain_point: FOD checks are paper-based at many stations — GroundStar task completion does not integrate with airside safety management system, preventing automated audit trail

l4_steps.name: Offload passenger baggage and ULDs
l4_steps.input: Offload sequence from LoadPlanner; ULD manifest from originating station
l4_steps.output: All baggage and ULDs offloaded and sorted to arrivals belt or transfer make-up area
l4_steps.kpi: First bag on belt ≤20 min after on-block; last bag ≤35 min for narrow-body
l4_steps.pain_point: ULD mismatch between manifest and physical load causes hold-up — SITA LoadPlanner relies on accurate originating station scanning; missing scan events create discrepancy exceptions requiring manual reconciliation

l4_steps.name: Offload cargo and mail per cargo manifest
l4_steps.input: Cargo manifest (AWBs, special load codes), ULD positions from LoadPlanner
l4_steps.output: Cargo offloaded to bonded shed or transfer unit; DG and live animal loads handled per IATA DGR
l4_steps.kpi: Cargo offload complete within 30 min of on-block; 100% DG loads documented per IATA DGR
l4_steps.pain_point: Dangerous goods (DG) misidentification at originating station discovered at offload — IATA DGR requires segregation but LoadPlanner DG flagging depends on shipper declaration accuracy

l4_steps.name: Perform lavatory and potable water servicing
l4_steps.input: Aircraft offload complete signal; lavatory service task assigned in GroundStar
l4_steps.output: Lavatory tanks emptied and rinsed; potable water tank filled to required level
l4_steps.kpi: Lavatory service complete within 15 min of task start; zero potable water contamination events
l4_steps.pain_point: Lavatory service vehicles (LSVs) are a single point of failure at smaller stations — delay cascades to all turns; IATA AHM 810 minimum water quality checks are manual and not digitally recorded in GroundStar

l4_steps.name: Calculate and uplift fuel per dispatch release
l4_steps.input: Fuel uplift order from dispatch release (Jeppesen FliteDeck / NAVBLUE); aircraft fuel gauges
l4_steps.output: Fuel uplifted to required quantity; fuel receipt signed and data transmitted
l4_steps.kpi: Fueling complete ≥15 min before scheduled departure; fuel quantity variance ≤50 kg vs. dispatch order
l4_steps.pain_point: Fuel density variation by temperature affects volumetric uplift — Into-Plane systems calculate in volume (litres/US gal); conversion errors between fuel slip and ACARS weight report create W&B discrepancies if not reconciled

l4_steps.name: Complete aircraft interior cleaning
l4_steps.input: Cabin cleaning task released in GroundStar after passenger deplane confirmed
l4_steps.output: Cabin cleaned, seat pockets restocked, galleys reset; cleaning sign-off in GroundStar
l4_steps.kpi: Cleaning complete within allocated turn time window; cabin cleanliness score ≥4.2/5 in post-flight survey
l4_steps.pain_point: Cleaning time is the most commonly cut activity during short turns — GroundStar task sequencing does not enforce minimum cleaning duration, and supervisors may sign off early under departure pressure

l4_steps.name: Load catering and provisioning per galley plan
l4_steps.input: Catering uplift order from catering management system; galley configuration file
l4_steps.output: All trolleys and supplies loaded to correct galley positions; catering doors secured
l4_steps.kpi: Catering loading complete ≥20 min before STD; zero missing trolley events per 1,000 turns
l4_steps.pain_point: Catering uplift errors (wrong galley, wrong count) discovered after door closure — gate-return for catering is operationally disruptive; caterers use paper manifests not integrated with Inform GroundStar task completion

l4_steps.name: Verify catering counts against flight specification
l4_steps.input: Catering delivery notes; passenger load forecast from Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Catering verification sign-off; discrepancy report raised if counts mismatch
l4_steps.kpi: Catering verification complete within 5 min of loading; discrepancy rate <0.5% of turns
l4_steps.pain_point: Passenger load changes after catering order cutoff (typically H-4) create over/under-provisioning — Amadeus Altéa PSS does not push live pax count updates to catering management system automatically

l4_steps.name: Receive final pax load and generate load plan
l4_steps.input: Final check-in closure data from Amadeus Altéa PSS; baggage weight data; cargo manifest
l4_steps.output: Load instruction report (LIR) with ULD build plan and position assignments
l4_steps.kpi: Load plan generated ≤10 min after check-in closure; load factor accuracy ±1% of actual
l4_steps.pain_point: Late passenger changes (gate adds, no-shows) after load plan generation require manual LIR revision — SITA LoadPlanner does not auto-recalculate when Altéa PSS pax count changes post-closure

l4_steps.name: Load passenger baggage per approved load plan
l4_steps.input: Approved LIR with ULD positions and weight targets per hold zone
l4_steps.output: Baggage loaded and locked in correct positions; actual weights per hold recorded in LoadPlanner
l4_steps.kpi: Baggage loaded per plan with ≤2% position deviation; loading complete ≥15 min before STD
l4_steps.pain_point: Ramp agents substitute ULD positions without updating LoadPlanner — actual vs. planned hold weights diverge, invalidating the W&B calculation and requiring a last-minute loadsheet reissue

l4_steps.name: Load outbound cargo and mail per manifest
l4_steps.input: Cargo manifest (AWBs); DG declarations; ULD build instructions from LoadPlanner
l4_steps.output: Cargo loaded per IATA ULD regulations; high-value and DG loads segregated and documented
l4_steps.kpi: Cargo loading complete ≥20 min before STD; 100% DG segregation compliance per IATA DGR
l4_steps.pain_point: Time-sensitive cargo (pharma, perishables) may miss cut-off due to late trucking delivery — SITA LoadPlanner does not integrate with off-airport cargo acceptance systems to provide early cut-off warning

l4_steps.name: Calculate final weight and balance
l4_steps.input: Final pax count and weights, actual baggage and cargo weights, fuel uplift confirmation
l4_steps.output: Final loadsheet with ZFW, TOW, CG% MAC, and trim setting
l4_steps.kpi: Loadsheet issued ≥10 min before STD; CG within certified envelope 100% of departures
l4_steps.pain_point: CG envelope violations caused by last-minute pax or cargo substitutions — SITA LoadPlanner CG alert requires manual Load Controller acknowledgement; no hard stop in system prevents issuance of out-of-envelope loadsheet

l4_steps.name: Transmit loadsheet to flight crew via ACARS
l4_steps.input: Approved final loadsheet from SITA LoadPlanner
l4_steps.output: Loadsheet transmitted and acknowledged by flight deck; printed copy retained per regulatory requirement
l4_steps.kpi: ACARS loadsheet transmission ≥8 min before STD; crew acknowledgement within 2 min
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS transmission failures at remote stations require fax or manual delivery — regulatory requirement (FAR Part 121 / EASA Ops) mandates crew receipt before departure; delays loadsheet delivery and pushes off-block

l4_steps.name: Disconnect all GSE and confirm all-clear
l4_steps.input: Doors-closed signal from cabin crew; loadsheet acknowledgement from flight deck
l4_steps.output: GPU disconnected, chocks removed, all GSE clear of aircraft; all-clear signal given to flight deck
l4_steps.kpi: All GSE cleared ≥3 min before off-block; zero FOD events during pushback phase
l4_steps.pain_point: GPU disconnect sequencing must precede APU start — uncoordinated disconnect in noisy ramp environment leads to momentary power loss events; GroundStar all-clear task is self-reported with no sensor confirmation

l4_steps.name: Coordinate pushback and engine start with ATC
l4_steps.input: All-clear confirmed; ATIS and pushback clearance from ATC via VHF
l4_steps.output: Aircraft pushed back to runway heading; engine start sequence complete; pushback crew clear
l4_steps.kpi: Off-block within 1 min of target off-block time (TOBT) for 78% of departures
l4_steps.pain_point: TOBT accuracy degrades during irregular operations — A-CDM TOBT updates from SITA AMS rely on all ground service completions being accurately logged; manual GroundStar updates lag real-time status, degrading ATC slot compliance
